name: Deliverynauts
summary:
Imagine a universe where you can traverse the cosmos, delivering vital cargo to distant planets of our solar system. Welcome to DeliveryNauts, a game that's more than just a space adventure – it's an experience crafted from dreams to explore the stars in reality.

In our initial release, Chapter 1: Coop, we introduce the foundation of our game – the cooperative system. Join forces with friends as you navigate through treacherous space hazards and defend your ship against pirate threats.
